journey: A shopper loads a browser-local photo folder, asks an agent to create one or more visible print drafts, reviews exact template-slot assignments and local crops, requests proofs when wanted, then explicitly adds completed drafts to a sandbox-only cart.

suggestions.name: ask_storefront
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper asks what photographs, print drafts, template choices, slot requirements, proof states, cart items, or sandbox limitations are currently visible. Returns grounded structured state and the next available action without changing the workbench.
suggestions.why: Agents need one trustworthy read of the visible tray, drafts, template contracts, and cart before acting.

params.name: question
params.description: The shopper's question about the visible storefront state or flow.

suggestions.name: find_prints
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper wants to browse, compare, or identify canonical print products before creating a draft. Returns matching published product facts and template requirements, and visibly opens the format chooser without inventing offers or compatibility.
suggestions.why: A natural-language print request must resolve to one real canonical product before configuration.

params.name: query
params.description: Product name, dimensions, category, or canonical ID fragment.

params.name: productType
params.description: Optional published product-type filter.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum results from 1 through 50.

suggestions.name: configure_print
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper wants to create or revise one visible print draft from photographs already in the tray. Selects a real product, applies the remembered or first compatible active template, exposes exact published image and text slots, patches assignments and non-destructive crops, and returns missing requirements; it never reorders or deletes tray files, uploads artwork, renders a proof, charges a card, or creates an order.
suggestions.why: One staged configuration journey should replace the manual product, template, output, slot, and crop click chain.

availability.note: Creates one visible draft per call and can update an existing draft by ID.

params.name: draftId
params.description: Existing visible draft to patch; omitted creates a new draft.

params.name: trayRevision
params.description: Visible tray revision used to reject stale photo references.

params.name: productId
params.description: Exact canonical product ID.

params.name: productQuery
params.description: Unambiguous product name or dimension query when no ID is supplied.

params.name: photoRefs
params.description: Tray photo IDs, left-to-right ordinals, or filenames considered for the draft.

params.name: templateId
params.description: Explicit active template override; otherwise use the remembered compatible template or first compatible server result.

params.name: outputId
params.description: Explicit compatible output; required when multiple orientations remain possible.

params.name: orientation
params.description: Human-facing output orientation when multiple compatible outputs exist.

params.name: slotPatches
params.description: Exact stable slot or unique-label patches for photo assignment, unassignment, text, zoom, focus, and offsets.

params.name: directCrop
params.description: Non-destructive crop for a direct-artwork draft using zoom and focus or exact offsets.

suggestions.name: request_server_proof
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper explicitly wants a server-generated JPEG proof for a complete visible template draft. Starts the published browser-preview job asynchronously, shows progress in that draft, and returns the proof job ID and framing-parity status; it does not create fulfillment artwork, add to cart, charge a card, or create an order.
suggestions.why: Server proof is useful evidence but must remain separate from animation-frame local editing and final fulfillment rendering.

availability.when: a visible template draft has every required slot assigned

params.name: draftId
params.description: Complete visible template draft to proof.

suggestions.name: add_to_cart
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper explicitly wants a complete visible print draft added to the local cart. Starts any required managed-artwork or fulfillment-render preparation asynchronously, keeps visible progress on the draft, and moves it into the cart only after preparation succeeds; it never starts checkout, charges a card, or creates a production order.
suggestions.why: Natural-language multi-product requests need each independently reviewable draft to cross an explicit reversible cart boundary.

availability.when: at least one visible draft has all required product and artwork inputs

params.name: draftId
params.description: Complete visible draft to prepare and add.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Quantity from 1 through 99; defaults to 1.

suggestions.name: manage_cart
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper wants to inspect, change quantity, remove, or clear items already in the visible local cart. Returns the resulting cart state and never changes source photographs, initiates checkout, charges a card, or creates an order.
suggestions.why: The agent must be able to correct a reversible multi-line cart without touching the person's photo library.

availability.note: Unregisters when the cart becomes empty.

params.name: action
params.description: Requested reversible cart action.

params.name: itemId
params.description: Visible cart item for update or removal.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Replacement quantity from 1 through 99.

suggestions.name: prepare_sandbox_order
suggestions.description: Use when a shopper wants the visible cart prepared for Batch Relay Test Mode review and quoting. Moves the workbench to the shipping review, applies only supplied non-sensitive fields, and returns the sandbox review or quote state; it cannot charge a card or create a production order.
suggestions.why: The demo needs a truthful final handoff that stops before payment or production fulfillment.

availability.note: Unregisters when the cart becomes empty.

params.name: shippingPostalCode
params.description: Optional postal code to copy into the visible review form; other required details remain visible user inputs.
